name: 71. Responses -> Chat finish_reason derivation (#6831) (finish-reason-derivation)
description:
Issue #6831: when a chat request targets a model whose datasheet lists /v1/responses but not /v1/chat/completions, the compat plugin marks ChangeRequestType=ResponsesRequest, core calls provider.Responses(), and BifrostResponsesResponse.ToBifrostChatResponse() converts the reply back. That converter never set FinishReason, and BifrostResponseChoice.FinishReason carries json:"finish_reason" WITHOUT omitempty, so every non-streaming converted reply serialized an explicit "finish_reason": null - breaking any agent loop that terminates on finish_reason == 'tool_calls'. Fixed by deriving the Chat reason from the Responses terminal state (status / incomplete_details / stop_reason) in chatFinishReasonFromResponses, and routing the streaming converter through the same helper so both paths agree.

Every row asserts extra_fields.converted_request_type == 'responses' FIRST. Without that guard a row silently passes on any chat-capable model, because markForConversion is datasheet-driven and the x-bf-compat header only enables the check - it cannot force a conversion.

exec: pm.expect(ef.converted_request_type, 'the compat chat->responses conversion did not fire, so this row proves nothing about the finish_reason mapping - the model must have /v1/responses but NOT /v1/chat/completions in its datasheet row').to.eql('responses');
pm.test('finish_reason is derived, not null - #6831', function () {
pm.expect(fr, 'finish_reason came back null on a converted non-streaming reply (regression of #6831)').to.not.be.null;
pm.expect(fr, 'expected stop for a completed reply with no function_call output item').to.eql('stop');

exec: pm.test('exactly one streamed chunk carries a derived finish_reason - #6831', function () {

if (ch && ch.finish_reason !== null && ch.finish_reason !== undefined) { reasons.push(ch.finish_reason); }
// Anti-vacuous guard, the streaming counterpart of the converted_request_type check the
// non-streaming rows make via pm.response.json(). An SSE body cannot be parsed that way,
// so read the marker off the frames instead: on a chat-capable model nothing converts, the
// marker is absent from every frame, and this row would otherwise pass on a native stream.

pm.expect(converted, 'no streamed frame carried extra_fields.converted_request_type=responses, so the chat->responses conversion did not fire and the finish_reason below proves nothing').to.eql('responses');

pm.expect(reasons.length, 'expected exactly one chunk carrying finish_reason, got ' + reasons.length + ' - the streaming converter emits it only on the terminal completed/incomplete event').to.eql(1);
pm.expect(reasons[0], 'streaming terminal reason must match what the non-streaming row derives').to.eql('stop');
